reflectance_input_units: fraction (nominal 0 to 1), not integer digital numbers
missing_policy: Required columns may contain NaN. Infinities become NaN. Each prediction row must have finite values in at least 50% of all 72 candidates and at least 50% of the target model selected features; otherwise it is rejected. The frozen model imputes other missing values with stored training medians.

mapping.mapping_support: local cells of 10 by 10 native DSM pixels in the historical map implementation
mapping.ground_reference: Matched corrected plot ground levels; plot polygons assign values, nearest plot centroid outside polygons in the historical map.
mapping.historical_feature_mask: OSAVI >= 0.3 for CC and CHM statistics; retain semantics of supplied feature layers.
mapping.display_mask: Use user-supplied mapping polygon and source coverage; OSAVI is not a final visualization mask.
mapping.osavi_predictor: OSAVI remains a fixed-model input; disabling a display mask does not remove this feature.
mapping.interpolation: Any display gap filling must remain distinct from original predictions and carry a quality mask.
mapping.scale_limitation: Plot validation does not establish local-window or pixel-level accuracy.

texture_contract.provenance: Historical stored layers with per-image normalization; original mean, std and correlation formulas are not interchangeable with standard GLCM library formulas.
texture_contract.policy: Use verified precomputed layers for frozen-model reproduction; new extraction definitions require validation.

AGB.Texture_NIR_mean: Historical NIR mean layer from the yield extraction stream.

Yield.Texture_NIR_mean: Historical NIR mean layer from the yield extraction stream.
Yield.Texture_G_std: Historical green std layer from the yield extraction stream.
Yield.Texture_R_std: Historical red std layer from the AGB extraction stream.

plausibility_policy: Bounds are review aids and are never used to clip predictions or alter fixed inputs. Training ranges are separate empirical summaries.

spectral_input_alignment.NDRE: (NIR-RE)/(NIR+RE); used in both frozen models and feature extraction.
